entities.summary: Elizabeth Nyamayaro is a political scientist and former senior advisor to Under-Secretary-General and executive director for UN Women. Nyamayaro is also the head of HeForShe, a movement founded by UN Women to empower all humans, especially men and boys, to have a voice and take action to achieve gender equality in their own lifetime.
